title: Fix command name collision between LSP auto-registration and extension
description:
The vscode-languageclient library auto-registers VS Code commands for each command in the server's executeCommandProvider.commands capability (see node_modules/.../executeCommand.js lines 47-55). The server declares 'badjuju.new' and 'badjuju.refresh' in COMMANDS. The extension manually registers commands of the same name, causing 'command badjuju.new already exists' errors when the extension activates.

The other commands work because the extension uses distinct names (badjuju.status.open, badjuju.describe.open, badjuju.log.open) that don't collide with the server-declared ones (badjuju.status, badjuju.describe, badjuju.log).

Fix: rename the extension's manually-registered commands to badjuju.new.open and badjuju.refresh.open for consistency with the other commands, and update keybindings/contributes.
close_reason: Renamed extension commands to badjuju.new.open and badjuju.refresh.open to avoid collision with LSP client auto-registration of server-declared executeCommandProvider.commands. Build and 36 tests pass.

title: VS Code client wires up badjuju.status.open command
description: In clients/vscode/src/extension.ts, complete the badjuju.status.open VS Code command. It should call client.sendRequest for workspace/executeCommand with command badjuju.status, take the returned URI, and open it with both workspace.openTextDocument and window.showTextDocument (currently the showTextDocument step is missing). Open the document with preserveFocus: false. Add a Command Palette title. The command should be contributed in package.json contributes.commands with a user-facing title like 'Bad Juju: Open status window'.

title: jj command runner module
description: Create server/src/jj.rs with a Jj struct that wraps the configured binary path and working directory. Methods: status() -> Result<String>, log(revset: &str) -> Result<String>, describe_get() -> Result<String>, describe_set(message: &str) -> Result<()>, new() -> Result<()>. Each method spawns jj with --no-pager and --color=never, captures stdout/stderr, surfaces non-zero exits as a structured JjFailed error with exit_code and stderr fields. Binary path comes from LSP initializationOptions.binaryPath (matching the existing badjuju.binaryPath VS Code setting) falling back to jj on PATH. Add unit tests under #[cfg(test)] exercising success and failure paths using a tempdir-initialized jj repo.

title: Server badjuju.status executeCommand handler
description: Implement the badjuju.status executeCommand in the Rust LSP server. Run jj status and jj log -r 'ancestors(reachable(@, mutable()), 2)'. Write a formatted buffer to <workspace>/.jj/badjuju/status.jj matching the layout shown in samples/status.jj: STATUS: section containing jj status output, WORKING COPY CHANGES: section, STACK: section with the revset shown and the jj log output below it, and a COMMAND REFERENCE: section. Return the file URI as the executeCommand result. Return a structured LSP error if no jj workspace is available or if jj fails.

title: Wire up tower-lsp server with lsp subcommand
description: The Rust server main.rs currently just runs jj status and prints it — no actual LSP server starts. Replace this with a working LSP server entry point. Parse CLI with clap: badjuju lsp runs the stdio LSP server, badjuju --version prints version. Create LspService::new(Backend::new) and serve over tokio::io::stdin()/stdout(). Advertise LSP capabilities: text document sync (Full), executeCommandProvider with command names badjuju.status, badjuju.log, badjuju.describe, badjuju.new. Add tracing + tracing-subscriber (env-filter, stderr output) so RUST_LOG=debug works. Split main.rs into modules: main.rs, server.rs (Backend impl), and lib.rs as appropriate. Add clap, tracing, tracing-subscriber to Cargo.toml.

title: Workspace discovery and shared server state
description: On LSP initialize, walk up from rootUri (or each workspaceFolder) to find the nearest .jj/ directory. Store workspace_root: PathBuf and a Jj instance in Backend state behind Arc<RwLock<...>>. If no jj workspace is found, log a warning and degrade gracefully — commands return a user-friendly LSP error instead of panicking. Log the discovered workspace root at INFO level using tracing. Add a unit test verifying discovery works from a subdirectory of the repo.

title: add squash and unsquash to status window
description:
add two new commands to the status window: Squash and Unsquash.

These commands are in effect when the cursor is on top of a changed file in the
STATUS area.

- When the cursor is on a file and squashed, that file change should be moved
  into the parent commit (`jj squash -r HIGHLIGHTED_REVISION FILE`). If the
  commit has multiple parents, this command has no effect and a descriptive
  error should be added to the buffer.

- When the cursor is on a file and unsquashed, that file chnage should be moved
  into the immediate child commit. If there is no immediate child or there are
  multiple, this command has no effect and a descriptive error should be added
  to the buffer.

title: vscode extension should bundle the badjuju binary
description:
The vscode extension should bundle the `badjuju` binary when it's built for
distribution.

When running locally, it's okay to just use the command available on $PATH if
that's easiest, but part of building the application should involve building
the server, then making it part of the VSCode extension bundle.

title: command pallet should show commands when `jj` is typed
description:
The commands in the vscode command pallet start with "Bad Juju". But if the
user types "jjlog", the log command is not shown.

Somehow ensure that typing "jj" in the command pallet filters down to Bad
Juju's command set. It's okay if other commands appear too, but Bad Juju
commands should be shown so typing `jjlog` and `jjst` run the log and status
commands, respectively.
close_reason: added 'jj' category to all commands so 'jjlog', 'jjst', etc. fuzzy-match in command palette

title: when  applying a log window shortcut revset, the cursor jumps below the OUTPUT section. It should stay where it was.
close_reason: Capture cursor line/char before triggering log refresh; wait for VS Code's file-watcher reload (via onDidChangeTextDocument, 1s timeout) before restoring cursor — avoids race where VS Code's auto-reload would reposition the cursor after our setSelection. Restores cursor to same (clamped) line/char so the user stays on the shortcut line they just activated. Biome/clippy/tests clean.

title: In the server, implement the redo script pattern for rust shown here: https://github.com/jennings/redo-cookbook/tree/main/rust
description:
Implement the pattern of redo script shown in that repository.

Add a file `configuration` that contains "debug" or "release" that  determines
which build configuration we build the rust project in. add a configuration.do
that sets it to "release" by default".
close_reason: added configuration.do (defaults to release) and updated server/all.do to honor debug/release

title: Add revset shortcuts to log.jj header
description:
In the log window, show example revsets as comments under the REVSET line so users can quickly pick a common revset. The VS Code extension should let the user place the cursor on one of these example lines and press Enter to apply it as the REVSET and refresh the log.

Examples to show:

    Mutable:    ancestors(reachable(@, mutable()))
    Stack:      (immutable_heads()..@)::

Server work:
- Update commands::run_log so the rendered log.jj header includes the REVSET line followed by a small list of example revset shortcuts (formatted as JJ: comment lines so they are stripped from any save path).
- Keep the existing REVSET parsing in on_log_save unchanged; example lines must be comment lines that on_log_save ignores.

Extension work:
- Add a keybinding / command in clients/vscode that, when the user is editing log.jj and presses Enter on a line matching one of the example shortcut formats, replaces the REVSET line with the example's revset value, saves the file, and triggers a refresh.
- The match should be based on the comment-line format the server writes (e.g. lines like 'JJ: Shortcut: Mutable    ancestors(reachable(@, mutable()))') so the extension doesn't need to hardcode the list.

Acceptance:
- log.jj header lists at least the Mutable and Stack example revsets under the REVSET line.
- Pressing Enter on an example line in VS Code rewrites REVSET to that example's value and refreshes log.jj.
- cargo test passes with no warnings; biome/tsc clean for the extension.
acceptance_criteria: log.jj shows Mutable and Stack example revsets as comment lines under REVSET; pressing Enter on one in VS Code applies it as the REVSET and refreshes the log; cargo test passes with no warnings
close_reason: Implemented: server renders Mutable/Stack revset shortcuts as JJ: comment lines under REVSET in log.jj; VS Code extension tracks cursor position via badjuju.onLogShortcutLine context key and rebinds Enter on shortcut lines to apply the revset and refresh. All 37 cargo tests pass with no warnings; biome and clippy clean. UI keybinding behavior not exercised in a running VS Code instance — server-side rendering and command logic are tested.

title: can't type revset characters in log buffer
description:
I can't type `r` in the revset in the log window, I think it's because `r` is
the rebase command.

If possible, only allow typing above the log output (you can add an OUTPUT:
heading to help delineate it), and don't try to interpret any commands there.

If that's not possible, then change the commands so they require modifier keys.
Add a command reference to the log window so the user knows what the commands
are. Update teh commands in the status window as well to match.
close_reason: Scoped 'r' and 'g' refresh keybindings to status.jj only (status is readonly so single-letter shortcuts are safe). Log buffer is now free for typing revset characters. Added OUTPUT: heading and a COMMAND REFERENCE section to log.jj. Updated status.jj COMMAND REFERENCE to match real keybindings (n=new, l=open log, d=describe, g=refresh, q=close — removed stale 'c=commit' and 'r=rebase' entries).

title: vscode status window should be readonly so the underlying file changing doesn't conflict with in-editor edits
close_reason: VS Code status.jj documents are now served via a custom 'badjuju-status' URI scheme registered with a TextDocumentContentProvider, which makes them inherently readonly. The provider re-reads the file from disk and fires onDidChange on refresh so updates appear without conflicting with in-editor edits.

title: Rust integration test driving the LSP server over stdio
description: Add server/tests/lsp.rs that spawns the compiled badjuju lsp binary as a subprocess, performs a full LSP initialize/initialized handshake over stdin/stdout, and exercises each executeCommand (badjuju.status, badjuju.log, badjuju.describe, badjuju.new) against a tempdir-initialized jj workspace (run jj init in the tempdir first). Verify each command returns a URI and that the written file contains the expected signature content: STATUS: in status.jj, REVSET: in log.jj, JJ: in describe.jj. Run with cargo nextest.

title: VS Code client badjuju.describe.open command
description: Register the VS Code command badjuju.describe.open (title: 'Bad Juju: Describe working copy') in clients/vscode/src/extension.ts. On invocation, send workspace/executeCommand with command badjuju.describe, take the returned URI, open with workspace.openTextDocument and window.showTextDocument with preview: false so saves behave correctly. Contribute the command in package.json contributes.commands.

title: badjuju.new command end-to-end
description: Server: implement badjuju.new executeCommand that runs jj new, then regenerates status.jj (same logic as badjuju.status). Return the updated status.jj URI. Client (clients/vscode/src/extension.ts): register badjuju.new VS Code command (title: 'Bad Juju: New commit'). Add a keybinding for the key 'n' when resourceFilename == status.jj and resourceLangId == jujutsu (using VS Code when-clause context). The status buffer should refresh after the new commit is created.

title: Server applies working-copy description on describe.jj save
description: On textDocument/didSave for describe.jj, strip all JJ: comment lines and the separator, trim trailing whitespace/blank lines, and call jj describe -m <content> (or via --stdin). After success, regenerate status.jj and notify the client. If the content after stripping comments is empty, leave the description unchanged (matching jj's own editor behavior). Return an LSP error notification if jj describe fails.

title: Server badjuju.describe command
description: Implement the badjuju.describe executeCommand in the Rust LSP server. Read the current working-copy commit description using jj log -r @ -T description --no-graph (or equivalent). Write .jj/badjuju/describe.jj with the current description text (or a blank line if empty), followed by a separator line and JJ:-prefixed comment lines explaining that the user should edit the description above and save the file. Return the file URI as the result.

title: Server badjuju.log executeCommand handler
description: Implement the badjuju.log executeCommand in the Rust LSP server. Accept an optional command argument { revset: string }; use jj's default revset if none is provided. Write <workspace>/.jj/badjuju/log.jj with content: a header line 'REVSET: <revset>', a blank line, then the output of jj log -r <revset>. Return the file URI as the executeCommand result. Return a structured LSP error if jj fails or no workspace is found.

title: VS Code client badjuju.log.open command
description: Register the VS Code command badjuju.log.open (title: 'Bad Juju: Open log') in clients/vscode/src/extension.ts. On invocation, send workspace/executeCommand with command badjuju.log, take the returned URI, open with workspace.openTextDocument and window.showTextDocument. Contribute the command in package.json contributes.commands.

title: TextMate grammar for .jj status files
description: Replace the placeholder jujutsu.tmLanguage.json (currently matches if/while/for/return — completely wrong) with a real grammar scoped to source.jujutsu. Tokenize the elements that appear in .jj status/log output: section headers (STATUS:, WORKING COPY CHANGES:, STACK:, COMMAND REFERENCE:, LOG:, REVSET:), change-id strings (short lowercase letter sequences like ynrzwrot), commit-id hex strings, bookmark names in square brackets, descriptions, (empty) and (no description set) markers, file-status prefix letters at line start (A, M, D, R followed by space), and graph characters (│, ◆, @, │, …). Provide meaningful scope names (keyword.other.section.jujutsu, constant.numeric.change-id.jujutsu, etc.) so standard themes apply colors. Update language-configuration.json to remove the incorrect C-style comment defaults.

title: Regenerate log.jj on save when REVSET header changes
description: The server tracks open documents via text document sync. On textDocument/didSave for log.jj, re-parse the REVSET: header line, re-run jj log -r <new-revset>, and rewrite the file content via workspace/applyEdit. The user edits just the REVSET: line to change the log view; saving triggers the regeneration. If parsing fails (malformed header), return an LSP error notification to the client.

title: Unify VS Code extension into single package
description: The project currently has two separate VS Code extension packages that need to be merged: clients/badjuju/ (language contribution: jujutsu language id, grammar, language-configuration.json) and clients/vscode/ (LSP client code). Merge them into a single extension at clients/vscode/. Move syntaxes/ and language-configuration.json from clients/badjuju/ into clients/vscode/. Merge the contributes.languages and contributes.grammars entries into clients/vscode/package.json. Delete clients/badjuju/. Add a working main field pointing to the compiled extension output, add activationEvents, and add a TypeScript/esbuild build step with build/watch/vscode:prepublish scripts. Fix the empty scopeName in the grammar (must be source.jujutsu, not empty string).

title: Repo cleanup and project metadata
description: Clean up stale scaffolding in the bad-juju monorepo. Delete the empty root-level vscode/ directory. Replace the incorrect Makefile (currently references dotnet csharpier). Fill out CLAUDE.md Build & Test, Architecture Overview, and Conventions sections with real content. Expand README.adoc beyond its current 3-line stub. Add clients/vscode/out/ and clients/vscode/dist/ to .gitignore. Add server to pnpm-workspace.yaml (currently missing despite being in root package.json workspaces).
close_reason: Deleted empty vscode/ dir, replaced dotnet Makefile with biome+cargo fmt/build/test, filled CLAUDE.md sections, expanded README.adoc, added vscode out/dist to .gitignore, added server to pnpm-workspace.yaml

title: CI workflow for Rust and TypeScript
description: Add a CI configuration (GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml, or equivalent for the local-only git setup) that runs in parallel: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo nextest run (or cargo test), pnpm install && pnpm -r run build, pnpm biome check . Cache the cargo registry and pnpm store to keep CI fast.

title: Configuration: binaryPath and defaultLogRevset settings
description: Confirm that the existing badjuju.binaryPath VS Code setting flows through to the server via LSP initializationOptions on startup. Add a second setting badjuju.defaultLogRevset (string, default empty meaning use jj's default) that the client passes as an argument when invoking badjuju.log for the first time. Document both settings in clients/vscode/README.md.

title: badjuju.refresh command and status-buffer keybindings
description: Server: implement badjuju.refresh executeCommand. It accepts the active document URI as an argument. If the URI is status.jj, regenerate the status file. If it is log.jj, re-run jj log with the current REVSET: header. Return the file URI after regeneration. Client: register badjuju.refresh (title: 'Bad Juju: Refresh'), bind to keys g and r when a jujutsu-language file is focused. Full status buffer keybindings when the status.jj file is focused: n -> badjuju.new, l -> badjuju.log.open, d -> badjuju.describe.open, g/r -> badjuju.refresh, q -> workbench.action.closeActiveEditor.

title: Align Neovim client with jujutsu language id
description: The Neovim LSP config at clients/neovim/lsp/jujutsu.lua uses filetypes = { 'jj' } but the project standardized on language id jujutsu and extension .jj. Update the config to use filetypes = { 'jujutsu' }. Add a Neovim ftdetect snippet or README so .jj files are recognized as filetype jujutsu. Document the setup steps for Neovim 0.11+ users.
